# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 9 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 33 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_009_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 9

**1** Jesus said: "Look, a sower [рефтово] went out. He filled his hand [ноучіж] and cast [нопт].

**2** Some fell on the road [тмоіт]; the birds came and gathered [соу] them.

**3** Others fell on rock [петра], and did not take root [хі новне] in the soil [кахе] and did not produce [рфт] ears of grain [сте].

**4** And others fell on thorns [шонте]; they choked [тохоу] the seed [сперма] and the worm ate [оуом] them.

**5** And others fell on good [нановс] soil [кахе] and produced [рфт] good [нановс] fruit [карпос] — it bore sixty [хе] per measure and one hundred twenty per measure."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *рефтово*: sower, one who sows; participial form
- *ноучіж*: "his hand" — sowing by hand broadcast method
- *петра*: Greek loan-word, rock
- *шонте*: thorns, thorn-bushes
- *сперма*: Greek loan-word, seed
- *карпос*: Greek loan-word, fruit
- Yield: "sixty... and one hundred twenty" — Thomas's yield differs from Synoptic versions
- Cf. Matt 13:3-9; Mark 4:3-9; Luke 8:5-8 — the Sower parable in all three Synoptics; Thomas's version is shorter and lacks an allegorical interpretation
